LanguageData.CR_CommandDescription: Review the cargo, members, animals, and problems for the caravan forming at this hitching spot.
LanguageData.CR_SelectFormationTooltip: Several caravans use this hitching spot. Choose one manifest; they are never merged.
LanguageData.CR_EmptyFormation: No caravan is currently forming at this hitching spot.
LanguageData.CR_ColumnsTooltip: Loaded: loaded units out of the requested total. Carried: units a colonist is carrying right now. Reserved: units claimed by a caravan hauling job. Waiting: units still waiting to be hauled. Problems: units with a known blocker.
LanguageData.CR_AllReady: No known blockers. Vanilla will depart when its remaining formation steps finish.
LanguageData.CR_ProblemUnavailableDetail: No usable source is available for {0} requested unit(s).
LanguageData.CR_ProblemInaccessibleDetail: {0} requested unit(s) cannot be reached by an available colonist.
LanguageData.CR_ProblemReservedDetail: {0} requested unit(s) are reserved by unrelated work.
LanguageData.CR_ProblemBurningDetail: A candidate stack is on fire and may be lost before it is loaded.
LanguageData.CR_ProblemForbiddenDetail: A candidate stack is forbidden. Vanilla caravan gathering may still use it, so this is informational.
LanguageData.CR_ProblemCapacityDetail: The manifest exceeds current capacity by {0}.
LanguageData.CR_MemberDownedDetail: This caravan member is downed and must be carried through the vanilla formation process.
LanguageData.CR_MemberMentalBreakDetail: Vanilla caravan formation is paused while this member is in a mental state.
LanguageData.CR_MemberUnavailableDetail: This member is not currently spawned on the formation map.
LanguageData.CR_MemberNoPathDetail: This member cannot reach the current gathering or exit point.
LanguageData.CR_MemberApproachingDetail: This member has not yet reached the current gathering or exit area.
LanguageData.CR_MemberWaitingRopeDetail: This pen animal has not yet been roped for caravan formation.
LanguageData.CR_MemberReadyDetail: This member is near the current gathering or exit point and has no known blocker.
